name: manual_ac0361
claim: Check whether a PR is already merged before reviewing or fixing it; a fix pushed to a merged branch lands on main, so read the merged state from main and extend the repo's one open PR instead of opening another.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-19: orama-system#419 merged before the follow-up review, so the spec was read from main and the fix went into the open preflight PR #423 at the operator's request.
